-----------------------------------------------------------------------

NUCLEAR REGULATORY COMMISSION

[Docket Nos. 50-616 and 50-617; NRC-2026-0265]


SMR, LLC; Palisades SMR, LLC; Pioneer Units 1 and 2; Phased 
Construction Permit Application--Limited Work Authorization

AGENCY: Nuclear Regulatory Commission.

ACTION: Notice; receipt.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------

SUMMARY: The U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) is providing 
public notice each week, for four consecutive weeks, beginning October 
1, 2026, of receipt and availability of the first part of a phased 
construction permit application, including a limited work authorization 
(LWA) request, from SMR, LLC, on behalf of Palisades SMR, LLC, a 
wholly-owned subsidiary of Holtec International (collectively, Holtec), 
for a dual-unit SMR-300 plant located at the Palisades Energy Center 
(PEC) in Covert, Michigan. The units are individually named Pioneer 
Unit 1 and Pioneer Unit 2. This is the fourth of four consecutive 
weekly notifications.

DATES: October 22, 2026.

ADDRESSES: Please refer to Docket ID NRC-2026-0265 when contacting the 
NRC about the availability of information regarding this document. You 
may obtain publicly available information related to this document 
using any of the following methods:
    <bullet> Federal Rulemaking Website: Go to <a href="https://www.regulations.gov">https://www.regulations.gov</a> and search for Docket ID NRC-2026-0265. Address 
questions about Docket IDs in <a href="http://Regulations.gov">Regulations.gov</a> to Bridget Curran; 
telephone: 301-415-1003; email: [email protected]. For technical 
questions, contact the individual(s) listed in the For Further 
Information Contact section of this document.
    <bullet> NRC's Agencywide Documents Access and Management System 
(ADAMS): You may obtain publicly available documents online in the

SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION:

I. Discussion

    On December 31, 2025, SMR, LLC, on behalf of Palisades SMR, LLC, a 
wholly-owned subsidiary of Holtec

[[Page 66741]]

International (collectively, Holtec), filed with the NRC, the first 
part (Part 1) of a phased construction permit application for a 
utilization facility pursuant to Section 103 of the Atomic Energy Act 
and part 50 of title 10 of the Code of Federal Regulations (10 CFR), 
``Domestic Licensing of Production and Utilization Facilities.'' Part 1 
of the application includes a LWA request pursuant to 10 CFR 50.10(d), 
``Request for limited work authorization''; three exemption requests; 
and a comprehensive environmental report (ER). In its LWA request, 
Holtec seeks NRC approval to conduct certain early construction 
activities of a dual-unit SMR-300 plant at the PEC in Covert, Michigan. 
Holtec also states that the comprehensive ER addresses the 
environmental impacts associated with LWA activities (including the 
requested exemptions), the remainder of construction to complete the 
plant, and plant operations. Holtec submitted Part 1 of its application 
as part of a phased application approach for a construction permit for 
a utilization facility, as described in 10 CFR 2.101(a)(9) and 10 CFR 
2.600(d).
    On February 27, 2026, the NRC issued a Federal Register notice (91 
FR 9892) stating that the NRC staff accepted Part 1 of the phased 
construction permit application for docketing and will perform a 
detailed technical review. These weekly notices of receipt and 
availability of the application are being provided in accordance with 
the requirements in 10 CFR 50.43(a)(3).
    Authority: 42 U.S.C. 2011 et seq.

    Dated: October 5, 2026.

    For the Nuclear Regulatory Commission.
Michelle Hayes,
Chief, Advanced Reactor Licensing Branch 2, Division of Advanced 
Reactor Licensing, Office of Advanced Reactors.
